module_summary: 64-bit arithmetic shift register: a single register synchronously loads data or, when enabled, shifts left/right by 1 or 8 bits selected by amount.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: 64-bit shift register contents, loaded or shifted each enabled cycle.

anchors.name: load
anchors.why: Synchronous load enable; overrides shifting and loads data into q.

anchors.name: ena
anchors.why: Shift enable gating all shift operations on q.

anchors.name: amount
anchors.why: Selects shift direction and distance (1 or 8, left or arithmetic right).

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Parallel load value written into q when load asserted.

groups.name: Shift register
groups.description: Load/shift mux selecting data or shifted q into the 64-bit register.
